"'''The New Droid Friends / Batuu Bonanza'''" is the first episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Three|third season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[December 8]], [[2025]].

==Official description==
''The Jedi face a new foe. Kai loses a package on Batuu''.<ref name="The New Droid Friends / Batuu Bonanza" />
